diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, spindle cell type
legend: Cohesive tissue fragments of spindle cells with oval nuclei with even chromatin; inconspicuous nucleoli; and long, tapered, wispy cytoplasmic processes (Pap).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, spindle cell type
legend: A tissue fragment consisting of irregularly arranged spindle cells with long cytoplasmic processes and elongated, oval nuclei with even chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli (Pap).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, spindle cell type
legend: A cohesive tissue fragment of spindle cells rounded up in an LBC preparation, making the long cytoplasmic processes less conspicuous than on direct smears. The elongated, oval nuclei are apparent (Pap).
Direct smears show polygonal epithelioid cells with round nuclei, which introduces carcinoma into the differential diagnosis (Pap).
A cohesive dense tissue fragment in an LBC preparation, consisting of rounds cells with relatively hyperchromatic nuclei, mimicking epithelial cells and carcinoma (Pap).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, spindle cell type
legend: Spindle cells with elongated wavy nuclei and indistinct spindle cytoplasm (cell block, H&E).
A direct smear shows a monotonous population of cells with eccentric plasmacytoid cytoplasm and mildly atypical nuclei, mimicking a neuroendocrine tumour (Pap).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, spindle cell type
legend: Spindle cells, often with indistinct spindle cytoplasm, show elongated, mildly pleomorphic spindle nuclei, some with a perinuclear vacuole, which offer a clue to the diagnosis (cell block, H&E).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, epithelioid type, succinate dehydrogenase–deficient
legend: Large, polygonal cells with eccentric cytoplasm imparting a plasmacytoid feature, present singly and in loosely cohesive tissue fragments (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, epithelioid type, succinate dehydrogenase–deficient
legend: Polygonal cells with eccentric plasmacytoid cytoplasm and variable nuclei seen singly and in a cohesive tissue fragment (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour, epithelioid type, succinate dehydrogenase–deficient
legend: Relatively monomorphic polygonal cells with eccentric plasmacytoid cytoplasm seen singly and in minute tissue fragments (Pap).
